answer: Collective Action License. Each agent identity must hold a license whose price rises on a fixed spiral as more licenses are issued within a rolling window; the marginal price is published as a live signal any agent can read before joining. To register N sybils, an attacker must buy N licenses at escalating marginal prices, so total cost grows superlinearly with N. Licenses decay like cedar: unused ones lapse, forcing sustained payment to keep fake identities alive.
